title: SellBridge Insights
text:
SellBridge Insights

notes:
- Lead: Emma Li (CTO) — early-stage SaaS, 18 engineers, building a lightweight call-summary widget for SMB customers.
- Use-case: generate short meeting summaries, extract action-items, surface redacted transcripts for reps. Emphasis on sales enablement integrations (HubSpot/CRM).
- Requirements (phrases from call): "We need to make sure customer PII never leaks to third parties; retention must be configurable per workspace; we want to redact emails/SSNs at ingest."
- Latency/throughput: soft target ~500ms median for short summaries; 60–120 reqs/min per instance expected during peak. Cost sensitive — want predictable per-seat pricing or cap.
- Model preference: open-ish models ok if quality matches; interested in Redwood's catalog + ability to fallback to smaller cheaper variant under load.
- Security: needs audit logs and exportable transcripts, KMS for keys preferred but will accept cloud-managed keys if audit trail present. Legal asked for sample Data Processing Addendum.
- Technical asks: API parameter to enable "redaction-first" pipeline, retention TTLs (30/90/365 days) and an immediate-delete endpoint, per-account opt-out. Also asked whether Redwood stores training data or uses customer data for model improvements — must be disabled.
- Quote: "If we can't assure redaction + configurable retention we'll have to keep transcripts on-prem or use a different vendor." — Emma Li.
- Current stance: interested in Hosted API (self-serve) for quick go-to-market; potential upgrade to Dedicated if volume/SLA justify.
- Action items: send Hosted API security FAQ, sample DPA + retention config, provide a short demo run with redaction + TTL set to 30 days, propose POC success criteria (accuracy of redaction, summary coherence, avg latency).
- Internal: map legal requirements to product feature flags (retention_controls, pii_redaction, immediate_delete). SE Samir to draft POC config; AE Jordan to loop in Growth for trial credit.
- Stubs: Fireflies ff_2026_03_05_9912, pricing deck drive:/decks/sellbridge_intro_hostedapi_v1.pdf, security FAQ drive:/security/faq-hostedapi-sellbridge-v1.md, Jira INF-4123 tracking redaction feature questions.
- CRM notes: shorthand, some repetition; Emma will introduce procurement after POC if redaction assurances meet legal.

activity_timeline:
2026-03-05 — Intro call (Fireflies ff_2026_03_05_9912). Quick demo of existing call-summary flow; they asked about PII redaction.
2026-03-08 — Security sync with Product + Legal: asked for retention TTLs, ability to auto-redact phone numbers and emails at ingest.
2026-03-10 — Email: sent sample hosted-api pricing and retention matrix (see drive doc). Follow-up on model fallbacks and cost estimates.
2026-03-11 — Customer completed self-serve signup and created an API key (trial). Running small batch of recordings through trial pipeline.
2026-03-12 — Call with Samir (SE): scoped POC; agreed on 2-week trial focusing on call summary + redaction automation. Next: POC config and security FAQ.
